message.content:
Build the "How It Works" page for the Boldteq marketing site.

**Project:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq`
**Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, CSS Modules

**IMPORTANT:** Read CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md first. This project uses Next.js 16.2.3 — read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` for any breaking changes. Never use `any` type. Read existing components for patterns before writing code.

**Files to create:**

### 1. `src/app/how-it-works/page.tsx` (server component)
Export metadata via `createMetadata` from `@/lib/seo/metadata`:
- title: "How White Label Web Development Works | Boldteq"
- description: "A simple, structured white-label delivery process built for agency workflows — from request to client-ready delivery."
- path: "/how-it-works"

### 2. `src/components/how-it-works/how-works-hero.tsx` + `.module.css`
Banner section with:
- Badge: "Boldteq Work" (gradient cyan text, same style as home hero badges)
- H1: "How Boldteq Works"
- Subtitle: "A simple, structured white-label delivery process built for agency workflows from request to client-ready delivery."
- 4 stat badges in a grid row: "White-Label by Default" (with icon `/images/webflow/Layer_1-3.svg`), "Senior-Level Team" (`Layer_1-25.svg`), "No Long-Term Contract" (`Layer_1-22.svg`), "Pause or Scale Anytime" (`Layer_1-26.svg`)
- GuideJar video embed: `<iframe src="https://www.guidejar.com/embed/xvH9rRaAyggwH1eetyrl?type=1&controls=on" width="100%" height="100%" style="position:absolute;inset:0" allowFullScreen frameBorder="0" />` wrapped in a 56.25% padding-bottom responsive container
- 2 CTA buttons: "See Plans" (link to /pricing, gradient button) + "Book a Demo" (link to /book-a-demo, navy button)
- Background: white with subtle gradient

### 3. `src/components/how-it-works/agency-fit.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "Boldteq Fits Quietly Into Your Agency"
- Centered heading + subtitle: "Boldteq operates as your backend delivery team — supporting your agency without changing how you sell, manage clients, or present your brand."
- 3 cards in a grid:
  1. Icon: `/images/webflow/Layer_1-21.svg`, Title: "Your Agency", Text: "You own the strategy, sell the work, and manage client relationships. You remain the face, the expert, and the decision-maker."
  2. Icon: `/images/webflow/Layer_1-37.svg`, Title: "Boldteq (Backend Team)", Text: "We operate behind the scenes as your white-label delivery team handling UI/UX, design, and development under your brand standards."
  3. Icon: `/images/webflow/Layer_1-38.svg`, Title: "Your Client", Text: "Receives polished, on-time deliverables as if produced by your in-house team. We stay invisible. You stay in control."

### 4. `src/components/how-it-works/how-works-steps.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "How White Label Web Development Works" — navy/dark background
- Badge: "How it works"
- Heading (white): "How White Label Web Development Works"
- Subtitle (white, opacity): "A structured execution system built for agencies — simple requests, predictable delivery, and full white-label support."
- 3 feature cards in a grid, each with:
  1. "Choose Your Subscription" + "Start scaling today. Your delivery team is live within 12 hours." + image `/images/webflow/Rectangle-243.png`
  2. "Submit Your Tasks" + "Submit requests anytime. We start within hours, not days." + image `/images/webflow/Rectangle-244.png`
  3. "Review & Approve" + "We deliver white-label work you can confidently send to your clients." + image `/images/webflow/Rectangle-186.png`
- Cards have white text on blue background, with image at the bottom

### 5. `src/components/how-it-works/process-steps.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "Built for Agencies That Need Predictable Delivery"
- Heading + subtitle + "Book a Demo" CTA link
- 4 numbered steps in a grid:
  1. "1." → "Subscribe to a Plan" → "Select a monthly plan based on the level of capacity, speed, and support your agency needs. No contracts. No surprises."
  2. "2." → "Submit Requests" → "Send tasks through our request system with clear instructions, references, and priorities. Everything stays organized — no long email threads."
  3. "3." → "We Deliver" → "Your dedicated Boldteq team handles execution, reviews, and refinements — following internal quality checks before delivery."
  4. "4." → "Review & Refine" → "Need changes? Submit revisions directly in the portal. We refine until the output meets your expectations and client standards."
- Each step has a numbered circle (gradient cyan text) + dashed divider line + heading + paragraph

### Page composition:
```tsx
<HowWorksHero />
<AgencyFit />
<HowWorksSteps />
<ProcessSteps />
<CtaBanner />  // from shared
<BetaCta />    // from shared
```

Import `CtaBanner` from `@/components/shared/cta-banner` and `BetaCta` from `@/components/shared/beta-cta`.

**Key references to read first:**
- `src/app/page.tsx` — page composition pattern
- `src/components/shared/page-hero.tsx` — hero pattern
- `src/components/shared/section-wrapper.tsx` — section container
- `src/components/shared/cta-banner.tsx` — CTA pattern
- `src/components/home/hero.tsx` + hero.module.css — for badge/banner styling reference
- `src/components/home/how-it-works.tsx` — existing 3-step component (similar content)

**Styling:**
- Use CSS Modules for all section components
- Navy (#082753), Cyan (#21cfff), Blue (#019ae6) brand colors
- Font: Roobert PRO (inherited)
- Responsive: stack to single column on mobile
- The "How White Label Web Development Works" section should have navy background (#082753)
- Number circles should have a subtle border and the number in gradient cyan

Zero TypeScript errors. Here is the complete summary of what was built.

---

**Files created:**

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/app/how-it-works/page.tsx`
Server component. Exports `metadata` via `createMetadata`, composes all four section components plus the two shared CTAs.

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/how-it-works/how-works-hero.tsx` + `how-works-hero.module.css`
Hero banner. Badge uses the same gradient-cyan text technique from `how-it-works.module.css`. Four stat badge pills in a 4-column grid (collapses to 2-col at tablet/mobile). GuideJar iframe in the identical 56.25% padding-bottom container used in `hero.tsx`. Two CTA buttons match the exact `a-gulf-book` / `a-except-get` button styles — gradient primary to `/pricing`, navy secondary to `/book-a-demo`. Gradient fade overlay at the bottom matches `gradient-bg-ban` from the home hero.

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/how-it-works/agency-fit.tsx` + `agency-fit.module.css`
White-background section. Three cards using the project's `card-hover` interaction pattern (background shifts to `#cdebfa`, border shifts to `#009ce0`). Icons are 48px, fully responsive — stacks to single column at tablet breakpoint.

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/how-it-works/how-works-steps.tsx` + `how-works-steps.module.css`
Navy `#082753` background section. CSS copied directly from `how-it-works.module.css` so the visual language is pixel-identical to the existing home section. Uses the same `featureCard`, `featureCardBlue`, and `fullWidthImage` patterns. The three screenshot images (`Rectangle-243/244/186.png`) are wired with proper `sizes` for responsive images.

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/how-it-works/process-steps.tsx` + `process-steps.module.css`
White section with 4-column step grid. Each step has a circle with a 1.5px `#21cfff60` border containing the number rendered with the same `gradient-cyan-text` gradient used throughout the site. Dashed connector lines between steps (`border-top: 2px dashed`) are hidden below 1200px. Grid collapses to 2-col at tablet and 1-col on mobile.
